description: This file defines the SerializedObjectDAO interface in the OpenMRS project, which specifies methods for persisting, retrieving, and managing serialized OpenMRS objects in the database, facilitating storage of objects with dynamic or complex schemas.

classes.name: SerializedObjectDAO
classes.description: Interface defining data access operations for serialized OpenMRS objects, including retrieval, storage, deletion, and type registration.

methods.name: getSerializedObject
methods.description: Retrieves a serialized object from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves a typed OpenMRS object from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getSerializedObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a serialized object from the database by its UUID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a typed OpenMRS object from the database by its UUID.

methods.name: saveObject
methods.description: Saves an OpenMRS object in serialized form to the database.

methods.name: saveObject
methods.description: Saves an OpenMRS object in serialized form using a specified serializer.

methods.name: getAllSerializedObjects
methods.description: Retrieves all serialized objects of a specific type, with option to include retired objects.

methods.name: getAllObjects
methods.description: Retrieves all non-retired objects of a specific type.

methods.name: getAllObjects
methods.description: Retrieves all objects of a specific type, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getAllSerializedObjectsByName
methods.description: Retrieves serialized objects by type and name, with exact or partial match.

methods.name: getAllObjectsByName
methods.description: Retrieves objects by type and name, with exact or partial match.

methods.name: convertSerializedObject
methods.description: Converts a raw serialized object into an OpenMRS object of the specified class.

methods.name: purgeObject
methods.description: Deletes an object from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getRegisteredTypeForObject
methods.description: Returns the registered class type for a given OpenMRS object.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported OpenMRS object classes.

methods.name: registerSupportedType
methods.description: Registers a class as supported for serialization.

methods.name: unregisterSupportedType
methods.description: Unregisters a class from supported serialization types.
